wind.meaning: Final A4MC gameplay physics wind vector at the query position.

updraft.meaning: Post-policy positive vertical component supplied by A4MC.

downdraft.meaning: Post-policy negative vertical component supplied by A4MC.

turbulence.meaning: A4MC-bounded gameplay turbulence intensity; Skyforge adds no remapping.

shear.meaning: A4MC gameplay shear magnitude; this contract adds no new bound or scaling.

altitude.meaning: Query A4MC at the consumer's actual world position; Skyforge defines no separate altitude atmosphere model.

pressure.meaning: A4MC normalized pressure proxy; it is not physical pressure and Skyforge defines no altitude-to-pressure curve.

trust_and_freshness.meaning: Use A4MC gameplay-policy trust/freshness handling; do not add a competing Skyforge trust model.

thermal_identity.test_identity: controlled A4MC authority state plus query position
thermal_identity.meaning: Bootstrap guidance/tests identify shared lift through deterministic A4MC field sampling and provenance, not a new persistent thermal entity.

ownership_and_reconstruction.save_reload_rule: Reconstruct by querying the A4MC authority after reload; never serialize a duplicate Skyforge atmosphere field.
ownership_and_reconstruction.server_rule: Gameplay authority is sampled on the server; semantic truth must not depend on a rendering backend.
ownership_and_reconstruction.implementation_proof: Issue #495 must still prove bounded update cost, dedicated-server safety, deterministic fixture behavior, and reload/reconstruction against the pinned runtime.

consumers.aircraft: Retained A4MC/Create Aeronautics compatibility may consume the same installed A4MC provider directly.
consumers.player_glider: Thin Skyforge compatibility code consumes trusted AeroWindApi.sampleGameplay output without creating weather state.
consumers.soaring_fauna: Behavior planning consumes the same trusted AeroWindApi.sampleGameplay authority without creating weather state.

shared_truth_rule: Consumers may interpret atmospheric truth differently, but must not own or fork per-consumer wind, thermal, turbulence, shear, or pressure state.
not_authorized: regional climatology or Phase-4 atmosphere expansion

provenance.role: gameplay sampling entrypoint and trust/freshness policy
deterministic public sampling and shared-provider semantics
accepted single-authority, soaring-fauna, and Reliable Gliders shared-lift boundaries
